  {"step":2,"file":"test/fuzzing/hb-shape-fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":8,"var":"blob","code":"hb_face_create(blob, 0)","note":"The blob is parsed as a font face, so malformed font tables from the input can influence later glyph lookups."},
  {"step":3,"file":"test/fuzzing/hb-shape-fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":9,"var":"face","code":"hb_font_create(face)","note":"A font object is created from the attacker-controlled face and will dispatch glyph metric queries into the font tables."},
  {"step":4,"file":"test/fuzzing/hb-shape-fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":10,"var":"font","code":"hb_ot_font_set_funcs(font)","note":"OpenType font callbacks are installed, enabling glyph extents to be read from the parsed font data."},
  {"step":5,"file":"test/fuzzing/hb-shape-fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":18,"var":"buffer","code":"hb_shape(font, buffer, NULL, 0)","note":"Shaping converts the fixed UTF-32 text into glyphs using the attacker-controlled font face."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/hb-ot-shape-fallback.cc","function":"position_around_base","line":313,"var":"buffer->info[base].codepoint","code":"font->get_glyph_extents (buffer->info[base].codepoint, &base_extents)","note":"The shaping fallback queries extents for the base glyph; this propagates the font-derived glyph id into the extents path."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/hb-ot-font.cc","function":"hb_ot_get_glyph_extents","line":138,"var":"glyph","code":"bool ret = ot_face->glyf->get_extents (glyph, extents);","note":"The glyph id is used to read glyph extents from the font's glyf/CBDT tables."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/hb-ot-font.cc","function":"hb_ot_get_glyph_extents","line":142,"var":"extents","code":"extents->x_bearing = font->em_scale_x (extents->x_bearing);","note":"The extents structure is scaled after the table read, so any out-of-bounds table access happens before this point."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p.read_text())
